reason: Integrity Technology Group is a cybersecurity enterprise, based in the People’s Republic of China (PRC), that facilitated cyber-attacks linked to Advanced Persistent Threat (APT) Flax Typhoon. Consequently, by affecting information systems relating to digital infrastructure, Integrity Technology Group is providing technical and material support for cyber-attacks with a significant effect which constitute an external threat to Member States and third States.
